verdict.rationale: The evidence documents versioned model IDs, `jev-latest`/`jev-preview` aliases, and advice to pin a version and "move to the new one on your own schedule." That is a versioning and alias policy, not a deprecation or retirement policy. Nothing in the pack describes retirement timelines, advance notice of model sunsets, or migration guidance for retired models, so the related versioning control earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on a documented deprecation policy with advance notice and migration guidance before a model I depend on is retired
